verdict.rationale: A probe finds an official CLI documented in Figma's Code Connect quickstart guide. Code Connect is a first-party tool that links code components to Figma and keeps MCP-generated code consistent with the codebase, so an official CLI exists but appears scoped to Code Connect rather than general agent-driven Figma work. missing for 10: documented CLI commands and scope, evidence of a general-purpose CLI covering file read/write and agent workflows, hands-on or independent corroboration of CLI use in AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Code Connect is a tool for connecting your design system components in code with your design system in Figma.
Code Connect keeps your generated code consistent with your codebase.
